rules.text: a quadriliteral root supplies FOUR independent radicals; R4 is licensed exactly like R1-R3, one radical per written letter position
the bare Form I quadriliteral perfect (فَعْلَل) is letter-decidable from a plain four-radical shape; nothing about voice or mood is inferred here

the مُفَعْلِل active and مُفَعْلَل passive participles are letter-identical once the radicals stand literally after the augment: this pack declares BOTH rows, so the cell collides and abstention is the honest verdict for unvocalised text
a three- or five-radical root never borrows a slot from this template family; the radical count must match exactly or the match fails closed to no_template

quadriliteral templates and triliteral doubling/gemination are DISTINCT families: this pack declares no GEM slot, and inc-gemination-licensing declares no R4 slot, so the two never collide by construction
